target: Close the untracked-work loop: expose git_detector.check_committed as an MCP tool and call it in the detect path so tracked work auto-closes when committed (>=80% file overlap). Logic exists but no tool/call wires it.
invariants: Every event stream must have >=1 publisher and >=1 consumer.
Fail-closed on protection/identity; fail-open on advisory/telemetry.
Deploy runtime proof required; no build-then-strand.

pr.title: feat(dopecode): auto-close untracked work on commit
pr.body: Feature-1 detection/track/remind/auto-track are done; auto-close-on-commit logic exists but is unwired. Expose + call it.

steps.task: Register an auto-close-on-commit MCP tool + invoke check_committed in the detect flow.
validation: A tracked item whose files land in a commit is auto-closed; unit test proves state transition detected->converted/closed.
